message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. At the top, bold red letters spell "TEMPO" against a white background. Below this, black text reads "EKSPANSI POLITIK HAJI ISAM." Further text on the left describes business concessions and political wings. The date at the bottom is "26 MEI-1 JUNI 2025."

The central figure is a heavy-set man with short dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt, dark trousers, and tan patterned shoes. He is kneeling on a white surface. In his right hand, he holds a long wooden paintbrush with a green tip, applying green paint to the top of a large chess piece shaped like a queen. The chess piece is light tan with green paint dripping down its sides onto the ground. In his left hand, he holds a small dark cup filled with green liquid.

Other text at the top includes "Adaro Minerals dalam Korupsi Pertamina H.40" and "Investasi Berisiko Danantara H.92." A barcode and QR code are located at the bottom right. Small green paint splatters dot the white ground around the chess piece.
